title: Latency Clamp All
prompt: A latency chart must keep every measurement inside a visible range. Write a function that returns a new array where values below min become min and values above max become max.

explanation.beginner:
Example: latencyClampAll([45,100,305], 50, 300) produces [50,100,300]. Apply both bounds so values inside the interval remain unchanged and outliers move to the nearest permitted bound.

Compare “keeps values inside the range”: input [[50,100],50,300] produces [50,100]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
